component.name: SimpleNotes
component.summary: A self-hosted Apple Notes that merges what was written apart

description.p: A small Apple Notes for Linux, macOS and iPhone/iPad. Every note is kept on the device and works offline; notes sync through a server of your own. When the same note is edited on two devices that could not reach each other, both edits end up in the note: nobody is asked to pick a version.

ul.li: Rich text with titles, headings, lists and checklists, block quotes, colours and highlights, collapsible sections, links, images, files and tables
Folders in folders, tags, smart folders, pinning, a gallery view, an attachments browser, search and Recently Deleted
Find and replace, printing and export as PDF, export as Markdown, and import from Markdown, Obsidian, Joplin, Bear and Trilium
Version history, kept by the server
Sync with your own server, or directly with your devices on the same network

screenshot.caption: Folders, notes and a note with a checklist
